sharedRules.name: Mike Target
sharedRules.description: When a Spotting Team successfully Ranges In an Artillery Unit with Mike Target, they may immediately roll to Range In another Artillery Unit. If successful, the second Artillery Unit Unit is treated as Ranging In on the same attempt as the first.

sharedRules.name: Canister
sharedRules.description: A weapon shooting with Canister suffers a +1 penalty to hit if it is using its Moving ROF.

sharedRules.name: Mountaineers
sharedRules.description: Teams frim a Unit with Mountaineers that start their Movement Step adjacent to a cliff or mountain side (or another similar Impassable terrain feature) roll a Skill Test. If successful, the Team may move using Terrain Dash across the terrain.
